mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicates accommodative monetary policy, reducing discount rates for equity valuation and producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS < 3.0% in the prior month, but S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in > 40% of such instances, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 5.0% signals labor market weakness, which typically leads to reduced corporate profitability and negative S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE > 5.0% in the prior month, but S&P 500 5-day returns are positive in > 40% of such instances, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in GDP (GDPC1) and housing starts (HOUST) indicates robust economic expansion, driving positive equity returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: GDPC1 and HOUST both rising in the prior month, but S&P 500 60-day returns are negative in > 40% of such instances, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS > 4.0%), rising interest rates compress equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS > 4.0% in the prior month, but S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in > 40% of such instances, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production index (INDPRO) reflects strong manufacturing activity, supporting corporate earnings growth and generating positive S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO rising in the prior month, but S&P 500 5-day returns are negative in > 40% of such instances, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: CPIAUCSL exceeding 200 indicates elevated inflation, prompting central bank rate hikes that reduce equity valuations and produce negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL > 200 in the prior month, but S&P 500 60-day returns are positive in > 40% of such instances, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is < 0.03.

failure_condition: PAYEMS > 135000 in the prior month, but S&P 500 5-day returns are negative in > 40% of such instances, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is < 0.03.

failure_condition: RSAFS rising in the prior month, but S&P 500 60-day returns are negative in > 40% of such instances, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is < 0.03.
